minting_rules.note: §3 is the id scheme (`csid` = `cs:<type>:<local>`, minted deterministically by engine/src/pinakes_engine/schema/ids.py — a QID when one is known, else a readable slug plus a hash of the normalized (name, lang) pair) and §3.1 derives the KINP forms from it: `pinakes:ent:<type>.<kinp-local>`. Minting is offline-first per KINP §6: nothing is asked of a peer, and a pre-reconciliation row is a `pinakes:local` provisional id until Wikidata reconciliation stamps a QID.

agent_card.note: Serves GET /.well-known/agent-card.json on the deployment's own origin (PINAKES_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, else the origin the request arrived on). No absolute `url` is declared because Pinakes ships no fixed public origin — the card is authoritative wherever it is served, and a URL committed here would be a guess.

manifest_source.note: The reviewed in-repo source the card's extension params are generated from (typed + validated by contracts/capability-manifest.ts). The served card stays authoritative; this is the document it is derived from and checked against. Pinakes also serves the same payload standalone at /.well-known/kcb-manifest.json — the superseded KCB 0.2.0 front, kept for the crawlers that already pull it.

mcp.note: Serves the KCB capabilities as MCP tools at /mcp (official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk) — the non-A2A endpoint the KCB §2 extension names as a plain params field.

policy.note: The per-record-class exportable/local-only assignment and the grounding-only dialect every knowledge port emits. Typed by contracts/egress-policy.ts, which is what capability-manifest.ts validates published ports against — so the policy is the source of truth, not a second copy of one.

license_policy.note: The `licensePolicy` block: the CC0 + CC-BY allowlist the exporters admit on, classified into KGP §7.1 classes by contracts/kgp.ts.

location.note: The bridge/predicate mapping between Pinakes's canonical node/edge vocabulary and the relation vocabularies of the projects it bridges, with per-entry dialect, egress and id-space rules. A generated mirror of koine registry/predicate-mapping.json (re-vendored by `npm run regen:registry-mirror`), because a published relation signature is immutable — the mapping coins no relation name, and a vocabulary gap is closed by adding a row upstream, never by naming a relation only here.

Pinakes's OWN bridge mapping for the pinakes<->insimul integration — grounding packs / world seeds out, converted worlds and the SLM datasets distilled from them back — versioned beside the code that performs the crossing (`scripts/export-insimul-pack.ts` and `engine/src/pinakes_engine/acquire/insimul.py`). It carries the per-direction id-space rules and the canonical node/edge correspondences, each resolved against `contracts/canonical-schema.json` and authorized by a `projects.insimul` entry of the mirror above; it restates no predicate of its own. Only all-public-endpoint bridges live here: a bridge with a non-public far endpoint is absent from this repository rather than redacted in it, so this list IS the set of public integrations.

registries.note: Best-effort push of the manifest to KCB_REGISTRY_URL at startup, when one is configured. Registration is fire-and-forget and serving never waits on it: with every registry down, a peer that dials this deployment directly still gets the whole self-description.
